text: So when we talk about Ukraine, it's, it's one of the biggest displacement of people that we have seen in recent years. We have broadly some 12 million people that have fled their houses. Some 7 million are still inside Ukraine, while the rest have fled the country and are currently in different countries in Europe. Here in Poland, we are assisting refugees from Ukraine, as I said, with cash assistance, which is the most efficient and effective way to support people forced to flee because they are able to purchase goods that they need the most. When the war started, you have just one hard question. Whether you stay in Ukraine or you want to leave, it's like basic and natural instinct to step up. In my case, as a volunteer, our organization is focused on those who are staying in shelters. It's not fast but process to proceed. All these donations with a traditional bank system we're able to provide first transactions within a week or so. Of course we are deeply grateful for any donors that support Ukrainian people. So we are not competing with like this program, with like United nations program. All of them are good, but technical superiority is obvious for us and the first benefit is speed of getting the donation. At our website we processed bank cards through different merchants and received a lot of donations. But due to bank declines, successful rate, what we receive at our bank account was around 70%. So with crypto, successful rate is always 100%. Literally in a first day of war, banking system completely shut down. Of course the first idea was to turn to crypto because crypto is still available to transfer. Just in a couple days we reach 15 million plus donation level. Crypto to cash program is actually a very simple program. We were able to donate directly to refugees through crypto. In the crypto based cash assist program. The three NGOs they work on the ground, help us select the eligible refugees and IDPs who are eligible for receiving the donation. They run a very rigorous screening process to select the eligible beneficiary. They will provide us with this approved list and the Binance charity will donate the crypto directly to the beneficiaries for all the transactions. It's recorded on the blockchain. So we ensure in this process 100% transparency and very minimal transaction fee. Currently we're using the BNB chain for every transaction. It's an average of 10 cents US dollar and we publish all of these records on our website. It's on the public ledger, everyone can review that. So this is something actually blockchain and crypto play a very important role because there is no cost and very minimal cost actually for the technology to empower the bottom billion people.
